name: Policy & Governmental Landscape
question: Do laws, regulators, subsidies, and geopolitics currently favor, tolerate, or threaten this business — and which pending changes could flip that?

signals.description: Open investigations, enforcement actions, consent decrees

recipe.query_template: {company} investigation OR enforcement action OR consent decree

signals.description: Pending legislation/rulemaking touching the sector; domain-scoped to legislatures/regulators + trade press
Subsidies, tariffs, export controls affecting company or inputs; 6h cadence during active policy cycles

recipe.query_template: {company} OR {sector} subsidy OR tariff OR export controls

signals.description: Licenses/approvals pipeline (FDA, FCC, antitrust clearances); agency-domain-scoped
Jurisdictional concentration (revenue exposed to one government's mood); geographic revenue split extraction from filings

recipe.query_template: {company} geographic revenue split by jurisdiction from filings

grade_anchors.A: Tailwind: subsidized/protected activity, no open enforcement, diversified jurisdictions.
grade_anchors.C: Neutral-contested: sector under active rulemaking with uncertain outcome, or one material investigation with plausible defense.
grade_anchors.F: Existential exposure: core revenue depends on a practice regulators have signaled intent to ban, or enforcement already restricting operations.

false_signals.description: Announced "compliance programs" or settlements framed as resolution while the underlying practice continues. Post-settlement news search for repeat violations.

recipe.query_template: {company} repeat violation OR continued practice after settlement

false_signals.description: Growth attributable to expiring government programs presented as organic. Agent run cross-referencing revenue-driver claims vs subsidy program timelines.

recipe.query_template: {company} revenue-driver claims cross-referenced against government subsidy program timelines and expiry dates

false_signals.description: The "moat" is only a licensing loophole. Flagged when the policy dimension is load-bearing for the value-creation grade (F9 cross-check).

recipe.query_template: {company} competitive advantage dependent on licensing loophole OR regulatory arbitrage

evidence_policy.notes: Regulator domains listed for US/EU; jurisdiction equivalents added per company at research time.
